prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1353; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in a sideswipe collision that occurred while the at-fault driver was changing lanes, and I am writing to notify your company of that representation. Effective immediately, please direct all communications regarding this claim, including any contact with my client, to this office. My client should not be contacted directly by you, your insureds, or any agent acting on your behalf.

Please provide the bodily injury and property damage policy limits for the insured driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and a statement of any other coverage that may apply, such as umbrella or excess policies. Please also confirm the claim number and the name of the adjuster assigned to this file.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Please suspend any routine destruction of these materials while the claim is pending.
